description: Looking for a private adventure with your close family and friends? Reserve our yacht for an intimate and exciting tour of San Diego Harbor. Our relaxed atmosphere, combined with the expert guidance of Captain Philip, will ensure that your journey is a memory that will last a lifetime. Perfect for special occasions such as birthdays, anniversaries, or family get-togethers, our private tours offer a personalized experience that you won’t find anywhere else. Join us for an unforgettable adventure on the sparkling waters of San Diego.

itinerary:
Maritime Museum of San Diego
Sail past a fleet of historic ships, including the Star of India — the world’s oldest active sailing vessel. A must-see for maritime history lovers!

USS Midway Aircraft Carrier Museum
Glide beneath the mighty bow of the Midway and experience the impressive scale of this floating museum dedicated to naval aviation.

San Diego Bay Wildlife
Keep your camera ready! Sea lions, dolphins, and pelicans often make special appearances alongside Liberty during your sail.

Coronado Bridge
When the wind and current are just right, we’ll sail beneath this sweeping 2.1-mile bridge connecting San Diego and Coronado — a picture-perfect moment.

Seaport Village
Ring the ship’s bell and wave to the crowd as we pass this lively waterfront filled with shops, restaurants, and street performers.

Cruise Ship Terminal
Admire San Diego’s grand ocean liners and panoramic city views as we sail by the busy cruise ship terminal on the Embarcadero.

Navy Ships & Bases
Get an up-close look at some of the world’s most powerful naval vessels — from aircraft carriers to destroyers — proudly stationed in San Diego Bay.
highlights:
Sailing the way it should be.Our vessel is truly a work of art, unlike any other boat on the bay. She is meticulously maintained with the highest standards of pride and craftsmanship. 

San Diego Sailing Adventures is a family-owned business that was established in 2014, We take great pride in providing our guests with unforgettable sailing experiences through the calm and picturesque waters of San Diego Bay, thanks to our small tour groups, unique sailboat, and experienced captain. 

Enjoy better value than our competitors with unlimited drinks and a longer time on the water. Indulge in white wine, craft beer, soft drinks, and snacks while taking in the breathtaking views. 

Escape the congestion of large tour groups
We only take six passengers at a time . If you would like a private sail book all six seats.

faqs:
Are there restaurants near by?
Our Harbor Island location at Sunroad Resort Marina is within a 5-minute walk to three waterside restaurants; C-Level (bistro), Island Prime (steaks and seafood), and Coasterra (modern Mexican). Tom Ham’s Lighthouse seafood restaurant is at the other end of Harbor Island, perfect for those who enjoy long walks by the water (1 mile, 20 mins on foot). The Boathouse Restaurant (surf n’ turf) at Harbor Island West Marina is a bit closer and has marina-side views.

What is your cancellation policy?
You may cancel your reservation without charge up to 24 hours prior to your scheduled departure. If you cancel within the last 24 hours or fail to show up at boarding, you will be responsible for the full amount of the charter/cruise. Weather-related cancelations will be determined by the captain. If your charter/cruise is canceled due to weather and we are unable to reschedule the trip to your satisfaction, you will not be charged.

Can We bring our own food and/or alcoholic beverages?
Yes, you may bring snacks and / or beverage you like, though please note : we do not allow red wine as it stains our vessel.

Will I get Sea Sick?
Daily harbor trips are conducted on San Diego Bay which provides a protected and smooth sailing experience.   Please note that any medication must be taken two hours BEFORE boarding the vessel.
